confirmedGap.oldConsumer: checks.ts runChecks obtains those inputs via TaskSpec
confirmedGap.autonomousConsumerBefore: agent-measurement.ts only called source-copy build and runtime-smoke; no supported selection/receipt for the existing consumption drivers
confirmedGap.whyThisChange: Agent can reuse established deterministic checks instead of requiring a host Task or independently rebuilding their browser mutation/projection logic. It does not force those checks on every project or guarantee the Agent chooses complete coverage.

implementation.probeSchema: Reuse existing Task probe field schemas only; no Task/Plan scheduling. Require unique selected driver IDs and matching actual probe inputs; reject ignored/unselected probe fields and unknown authorization fields.
implementation.lifecycle: Reserve existing measurement identity before build, use existing native writer/CAS and cancellation signal; run selected drivers only after passed actual source-copy build/smoke. No automatic retry/model/scheduler/source mutation.
implementation.identity: Record normalized optional configuration in existing measurement JSON; same request-key replay reads saved evidence. Different checks/probes cannot reuse that identity; sameJson avoids JSON object-order conflicts.
implementation.qualification: Missing, failed, unsupported or obsolete requested consumption checks remain unverified; build/smoke alone does not qualify that explicitly selected measurement. Source/report/dependency/artifact freshness remains required, with latest incomplete/failure preserved.
implementation.visibility: Existing compact/detail inspection, context/handoff and debug reading show recorded selection/status/observations. Export measurement.json retains selected probe contract and public consumption checks; inputs/requirement metadata remain omitted as with existing exported smoke.
implementation.defaults: Without explicit consumption parameters, original measurement/context/export behavior and input scope remain. No default full probe list or new production/Review prompt.
implementation.database: Existing JSON Run/AgentMeasurement metadata only; no SQL/table/RPC added or executed. No new remote fault acceptance inferred.

regression.counting: Core and transport have disjoint files, 181 distinct cases. Final affected 54 overlap them and are not added. Final rerun includes the export receipt additions and missing/obsolete-check counterexamples.

environment.model: Existing local controlled provider only, no paid calls

coverage: Actual CLI adapter against four independently rendered synthetic target builds: DOM geometry, Scene Canvas pixels with Camera/scale, DOM font/text and decoded HTML audio behavior
A synthetic renderer ignoring layout or Camera fails consumption even though build and smoke pass; requested failure cannot be silently exported as the selected measurement
Exact source bytes preserved during browser-response mutations; selected check observations and contract included in editable export, private workflow inputs excluded
Request replay without reexecution/store change, changed-contract identity conflict, missing result, obsolete driver version and changed source invalidation
Existing native goal/Skill/Question/delegation/guide/discussion/change/continuation, Task compatibility, source editing, Preview/export permissions and old receipt paths
initialFailures: New fixture initially treated sharedSharp metadata as callable; used its actual module URL and corrected the test access rather than changing runtime API.
Pixel check correctly rejected a new synthetic renderer that ignored transform.scale; fixture was corrected to consume scale. Product geometry checks were not loosened.
Editable export correctly rejected /var versus /private/var temporary-root alias; canonicalized only the synthetic fixture root, did not weaken alias refusal.
New test observation union needed property assertion instead of unsafe direct access; canonical root typecheck then passed.

integrity.hashMethod: Existing public nonhidden-file audit, excluding node_modules/transcripts; not a claim to hash all hidden files.

limitations: Offline tests prove this interface/driver integration, not real Agent selection/use, design sufficiency, all gameplay states, aesthetics, fun or listening quality.

Scope is the existing static-Web drivers: representative DOM/UI geometry, supported static Canvas image/Tilemap projection, supported DOM font binding or HTML audio. GPU/3D, dynamic occlusion, WebAudio, full mix/listening and arbitrary engines remain outside that proof.
No native engine development, real database edit crash combination, real external paid recovery or formal product release acceptance was performed.
Existing real game findings and navigation prose remain untouched and unclosed. No receipt, regression total or new optional endpoint is a whole-game PASS.
